assets.alt: A low dark wooden writing table seen from above in morning light. Sun comes through a wooden lattice window at the top and lays a pattern of small soft shapes on the wood. The middle of the table is bare. Around its edges lie an open ledger, a brass balance scale with small weights, an inkwell with two reed pens, stacks of gold and silver coins, a few folded letters tied with thread, and an unlit clay oil lamp.
The same writing table and the same objects at dusk. Low orange light stretches the shadows of the lattice across the wood, and the room is dimming. The middle of the table is bare.

The same writing table at night. The oil lamp is lit and makes a small warm pool of light on the wood with deep shadow beyond it. A little cold moonlight shows at the window strip. The middle of the table is still light enough to read dark text on a pale card.

A model of the lands from West Africa to India, carved and painted as if from wood and plaster, lying on a table in low window light from the upper left. Pale sand shows the deserts, dull green the Nile valley and the shores of the Mediterranean and India, and grey-brown the mountains, which cast shadows. The sea is dark blue-green and shiny. The Nile, the Niger, the Tigris and the Euphrates are thin inlaid lines. There are no names or markings.

The north gate of Cairo seen from outside the walls at dawn. A stone gate with a round arch stands between two square towers in a long wall of pale limestone blocks, lit by the first sun on its upper stones. Mist and dust lie near the ground. Far off and small, a caravan is forming, with kneeling camels, bales and a few cloaked figures. Flat roofs, domes and minarets stand behind the wall.

The harbour of Alexandria seen from a worn stone quay in late light. Calm water shines in a wide bay. Ships with long slanting yards lie at anchor, with one long low galley and its oars, small rowing boats, and the dark hull of a big round ship close by at the quay. On the far shore stand the low houses of the town and the square broken stump of a huge old lighthouse tower. Jars and bales sit on the quay.

A port on a hot, bare Red Sea shore. A few low buildings of coral stone and rows of shelters of matting and reed stand along a wide sandy beach. Dhows with one slanted sail lie at anchor in clear green-blue water, and one is drawn up on the sand. Bare brown hills rise behind under a blue sky with white clouds.
Great sand dunes in late sun, with long blue shadows in the hollows. Along one far crest a long line of camels and walkers shows as tiny dark shapes.

A high mountain pass between rock walls under heavy cloud, with snow falling. A narrow track climbs through deep snow to a notch in the ridge. A stone cairn and a small rough stone shelter with a thread of smoke stand beside it. Far up the track, a few loaded mules and two-humped camels and some walkers show as tiny dark shapes.

The courtyard of a roadside inn for caravans at night, seen from a corner of the upper gallery. Two floors of pointed arches ring a square court with one great studded wooden gate and a basin in the middle. Oil lamps glow warm in the arches against cold moonlight on the stone. Camels kneel in the court, bales are stacked, and a few cloaked figures sit by a small fire far below.

A mud-brick town across a wide slow river in late, dusty gold light. Smooth earthen walls with flat roofs surround a mosque with tall rounded towers. A few flat-topped thorn trees and one great thick-trunked tree stand on the bank.

Inside a long covered market street with a stone vault, empty in the early morning. Shafts of sun fall through openings in the roof into dusty air. Raised stone stalls along both sides hold sacks of spice and grain, copper pots and jars. A pointed arch at the far end opens on bright light.

A green tropical shore under a huge bank of monsoon cloud, with one break of light on the water. Grey curtains of rain fall out at sea. Coconut palms bend in the wind. Sewn-plank boats are hauled up the beach above the surf, and wooden warehouses with steep thatched roofs stand behind. Far out at anchor lies one very large Chinese junk with several masts and battened sails.

The water front of a trading city on a lagoon, in misty early light. Long brick warehouses with rows of round arches stand at the water, with wooden mooring poles in front. A galley with a long slanting yard is moored at the quay.
A small still life on a clear ground with a soft shadow: a small cloth sack of black peppercorns, its top rolled down, with a few spilled.
A small still life on a clear ground with a soft shadow: two bolts of shining cloth, one deep red and one gold-yellow, with an end unrolled.
A small still life on a clear ground with a soft shadow: a few gold coins and a small open leather pouch of gold dust.
A small still life on a clear ground with a soft shadow: a grey-white slab of rock salt, roped.
A small still life on a clear ground with a soft shadow: a pale grey-green glazed bowl and a small jar, with no painted pattern.
A small still life on a clear ground with a soft shadow: a blown bottle and a beaker, slightly green or amber and a little uneven.
A small still life on a clear ground with a soft shadow: folded lengths of off-white cloth with a visible weave.
A small still life on a clear ground with a soft shadow: two tall white cones of hard sugar, one of them chipped.
A small still life on a clear ground with a soft shadow: a bowl of pale yellow resin lumps beside a small brass burner.
A small still life on a clear ground with a soft shadow: a stack of rough red-brown copper bars.
A small still life on a clear ground with a soft shadow: a heavy bolt of dark blue wool cloth.
A small carved playing piece of dark wood with brass details on a low round base: a string of three one-humped camels.
A small carved playing piece of dark wood with brass details on a low round base: a dhow with a single slanted sail.
A small carved playing piece of dark wood with brass details on a low round base: a galley with oars.
A small carved playing piece of dark wood with brass details on a low round base: a Nile boat with one tall slanted sail.
A small carved playing piece of dark wood with brass details on a low round base: a pair of laden mules.
A sheet of paper folded into a narrow packet and tied with thread, with a small stamped mark on the fold.
The same letter unfolded flat, with fold lines showing. The upper two thirds are covered in faint lines of ink that cannot be read, and the rest is empty.
A sheet of pale handmade paper, slightly uneven in colour, with fold lines and no writing.
A long sheet of paper with faint lines of ink and, at the foot, a row of four small stamped marks.
A bound paper book lying open flat, faintly ruled and mostly empty.
A few gold and silver coins together, seen from above.
Some gold and silver coins together, seen from above.
Many gold and silver coins together, seen from above.
A stamped mark in dark ink, showing a star of eight points.
A stamped mark in dark ink, showing a knot.
A stamped mark in dark ink, showing a palm leaf.
A stamped mark in dark ink, showing a ring of dots.
A stamped mark in dark ink, showing a crescent of leaves.
A stamped mark in dark ink, showing a lozenge.
A stamped mark in dark ink, showing a wheel.
A stamped mark in dark ink, showing a rosette.
A single round ship climbing a great grey swell under a black sky, small in the frame, with one torn sail and spray flying. No crew can be seen.
A field of dunes with a brown wall of dust hundreds of metres high rolling in from one side. The sun is a dull disc behind it. A caravan has halted, and the camels kneel as small dark shapes.
A dry valley road between sandy hills, closed by a small stone fort with notched walls and a wooden bar across the way, in harsh daylight. A plain red banner with no mark on it flies from the tower.

A very large camp of tents on the edge of the desert in dusty gold evening light, with hundreds of camels and people as tiny shapes, and the three great pyramids beyond. Here and there a glint of gold shows.
The Alexandria harbour under flat grey light. The quay is bare, no boats are moving and no goods lie about. One ship alone lies at anchor far out with its sails furled.

The view from the window of a merchant's room at dawn, looking out through an open wooden lattice screen over the roofs, domes and minarets of Cairo, hazed and far away, to the river and a pale sky. On the sill in the foreground, a little out of focus, lie a sealed letter and a small brass balance. The upper left third of the picture is plain sky.
The same view over the roofs and minarets of Cairo at dawn, cropped wide for sharing, with plain pale sky at the upper left.
